dataset: MIT-BIH Arrhythmia (5 AAMI classes), ECG-signal modality
model_selection: best macro-F1 on a stratified validation split carved from train (test set never used for selection)
class_weighting: inverse-frequency class weights on the arrhythmia CE loss
loss_weighting: learned homoscedastic uncertainty (Kendall et al., CVPR 2018)
multimodal_note: Single-modality training. Joint 4-modality fusion + contrastive alignment NOT trained — requires same-patient paired data absent from public benchmarks.
